title: Bit c = 0.001733052823: #545's punctured unit on the R420 skeleton (111 live ports, +4.79% over #543)
body:
**Bit c = 1733052823330162099157/10²⁴ = 0.001733052823330162099157 at nine stages** (R = 439 helpers, v = 111 live ports, decoder constant 63). That is +4.79% over #543's R420 word in the same pipeline and +4.43% over #545's punctured R489 unit. Every cited complex supplier binds: with #548's b the conditional **κ = 49718254847979/31250000000000000 = 0.001590984155135328** (complex-bound; #548 is an open PR). The value of this word is bit headroom: κ stays complex-bound until a complex b exceeds 0.00173.

**Concurrent PRs.** While this was being verified, #551 (chafreaky) and #552 (Dugongue) reported κ = 0.001591968902833346 with stronger complex suppliers, #551 paired with #543's R420 word. Any of those complex suppliers is also complex-bound with this word, so they set κ. This PR does not claim a κ above them; it raises the bit ceiling from 0.00165383 (#543) to 0.00173305.

This PR stacks the punctured-star unit of #545 (DreamingOfClouds) on the R420 L3 skeleton of #543. Nine E8 lines are neither sources nor targets, and each of the nine retained totals is a pseudo-target that reads what the removed target would read, at frame rank 7.

The same κ values hold with #543's word, since its c is also above every cited b (#547 reports the #548 value with it).

### Why #545's construction needed a change on L3

In #493's skeleton the Q-node runs in phase A, so a pseudo-target can read everything a target reads before the scatter. In L3 the block node runs in phase B, after the targets have read its source registers at their cells. A retained total is read at the scatter, at the end of phase A, so the part of a target's sum that the block node delivers (the live lines of the complementary block B) is not available to a pseudo-target. In a 4-frame with one punctured line, the pseudo-target also needs an odd number of single d-line reads.

The pseudo-target total of a punctured line p (a fresh helper):
- reads the source of kline(p) at its line frame, before that line's cell gate;
- reads o1 at D6[p, qhost(p)] (it takes the place of the third register qdel[p]);
- reads p's needers at its two (z,z) D6s at p⊥. One of them is a free keeper of B that a phase-A mini-node at the block frame D4(B) rewrote to carry the pseudo-target's B-part. The mini-node reads the other free keepers of B, the sources of B that no target reads (the source in a punctured target's d-single cell), and extra carriers (helpers that read a source of B at its line frame) for the remaining lines.

The 9 totals are fresh helpers and 10 extra carriers are needed, so R = 420 + 9 + 10 = 439. The extra carriers also serve as junk wires of the block nodes. The decoder needs the classes of P in E8/2E8 to be affinely independent. A complementary D4 pair spans only 6 dimensions (affine rank 7), so P meets two block pairs: P = [10, 15, 51, 53, 56, 66, 72, 89, 111] in blocks (0,1) and (3,5). #545's own P is not eligible under #543's plan, because the frame (z,z) structure of its line 39 does not fit.

**Rank-mass identity.** At nine stages it reads T(8v − 9·cst) = 32·321 = 10,272. The hosting wall R ≤ 4v = 444 admits R = 439, and all 126,432 residuals are hosted whole with no banks.

### Checks (`bash research/e8-bit-p111/verify.sh DIR`, about 4 minutes)

- **Provenance.** Manifest; 19 files from #510 and 5 from #545, plus 2 receipts each from #548, #544 and #535, all by git blob id; main's files by sha256. Every b is checked against its receipt. #548's, #544's and #535's own κ are recomputed from their receipts, and all 47 constraint values equal their exact-assembly receipts.
- **Rebuild.** The word is rebuilt from #543's plan and frozen parameters, byte for byte.
- **Independent replay (`code/xcheck_p.py`, reads only the word).**
  - The 111 labels are root lines of an even unimodular rank-8 lattice, and the 9 punctured lines are found by enumerating its roots.
  - Frames are closed in the live labels.
  - Exact F₂ replay on all 661 columns.
  - The 9 totals sit at the hyperplanes of the 9 punctured lines, with COPY ranks 7 × 9 = 63.
  - (H1)–(H5) of #543's interleaved interface lemma hold, and its conclusion is checked.
  - #543's 9 + 1 controls and 4 punctured-design controls are rejected.
- **Hub checkers.** #545's v ≤ 120 form of #370's checker refuses, its relaxed copy passes, and #493's `interface.py` refuses at check (4), as for #543.
- **Official checkers at (111, 439).**
  - Legality: 27,234 records, rank mass 5,129 = 8R + 63 + 14v.
  - Five-stage columns: 883, payload 93 bits.
  - Nine-stage columns: 1,327, 18/18 controls.
  - Eleven-stage columns: 1,549, 24/24 controls.
  - The KPAIRS = 2 regression, record mutants, and Gram witnesses on 636 frames.
- **Nine-stage price (`code/adapt9p.py`: 27 listed edits to #510's files).**
  - The hosting selection is rediscovered, the parent and hosted audits pass, and all 126,432 residuals are hosted whole.
  - Invoice: prefix 177 bits (charged 192), two-level 393 (charged 512), row 18,355.
- **Eleven-stage price (#545's `adapt.py`).**
  - All 38,632 residuals are hosted whole and the audit passes.
  - Invoice: prefix 4,304 (charged 4,352), three-level 12,966 (charged 12,992).
- **Controls.**
  - On #510's R480 word, the parameterised nine-stage files give the same template, audits and RESULT as #510's vendored files, byte for byte. They reproduce #510's c and κ values, and #535's κ with #535's b.
  - #545's word through #545's files reproduces #545's c, profile and program hash.

### Retained assumptions

As for #543 (mutable-basis realization, interleaved interface lemma) and #545 (a 111-port bit supplier in the outer assembly; #442 whole-call hosting). Complex savings are cited from receipts. #548, #544 and #535 are open PRs, and #548 also retains #539's bad-class transport as a premise. This is a conditional finite construction, not a Lean proof.
